# Online Tech Tips

> A comprehensive tech resource providing practical how-to guides, software reviews, and troubleshooting tips across social media, AI applications, streaming services, mobile devices, and computing platforms.

Online Tech Tips offers accessible technology advice for everyday users, covering social media platforms like Facebook and Snapchat, mobile operating systems (Android and iOS), desktop environments (Windows and macOS), and emerging AI tools. The site combines step-by-step tutorials with product comparisons to help readers optimize their devices and discover new technologies.

## Social Media & Privacy Guides

- [How to See Who Blocked You on Facebook](https://www.online-tech-tips.com/how-to-see-who-blocked-you-on-facebook): How-to guide for detecting Facebook blocks using Messenger and profile methods.
- [What Does the Green Dot Mean on Facebook?](https://www.online-tech-tips.com/what-does-the-green-dot-mean-on-facebook): Explanation of Facebook and Messenger green dot online status indicators.
- [How to Stop Friend Suggestions on Facebook](https://www.online-tech-tips.com/how-to-stop-friend-suggestions-on-facebook): Instructions for disabling Facebook friend suggestions on desktop and mobile.
- [Does Facebook Tell You if Someone Screenshots Your Story?](https://www.online-tech-tips.com/does-facebook-tell-you-if-someone-screenshots-your-story): Explanation of Facebook screenshot notification policy compared to Snapchat.
- [How to Clear Facebook Cache on iPhone](https://www.online-tech-tips.com/how-to-clear-facebook-cache-on-iphone): Step-by-step guide for clearing Facebook app cache on iOS devices.
- [How to See Mutual Friends On Snapchat](https://www.online-tech-tips.com/how-to-see-mutual-friends-on-snapchat): Tutorial for viewing mutual friends on Snapchat using Quick Add feature.
